==Trivia==

*This skill was heavily [[nerf]]ed in the [[Game updates/20080821|August 21, 2008 update]] to effectively remove it from PvP. Its modification was explained in that update's [[ArenaNet:Developer updates/20080821|developer update]].
**The heavy handed nature of the nerf became a meme in the community, giving rise to the terms ''(Smiter's) Booning'' and ''25/90ing'' (referring to the new energy cost and recharge) each time a skill is heavily nerfed or rendered completely unusable after a game update.
***The skill [[Isaiah's Balance]] is a direct reference to this nerf.
**In March 2015, [[Isaiah Cartwright]] [http://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/2yigwn/thank_you_pax_east_fans_had_a_great_time/cpad1gq explained] the process of him and [[James Phinney]] nerfing this skill.
**Isaiah returned 18 years later to further nerf the skill in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260205|February 5, 2026 PvP Balance update]].
**The recharge time was reduced by 1 second in the [[Feedback:Game updates/20260401|April 1, 2026 update]]. This change was reversed [[Feedback:Game_updates/20260428|four weeks later]].
